title: Two new verbatim copies of the demo-replay setup boilerplate added beside the new shared run driver
detail: The diff factored the replay loop into run_demo_to_ms (W4) yet added two more copies of the ~30-line setup block, now 3 copies in PP_DEBUG verbs plus run.odin/motion_strip. A Demo_Replay field addition must be threaded 5+ places — exactly the drift class the codebase already hit (overlay_check's '6.2 r2 W2: the B1 flag-threading's residual site' comment).
recommended_fix: Hoist parse→run_init→cfg→appends→demo_apply_setup→lower_intents into a shared helper beside run_demo_to_ms (e.g. demo_replay_setup(demo, cat)) and call it from overlay_check, overlay_pixels_check, and font_check.

title: Readable fallback yielding zero requested glyphs silently ships an incomplete atlas
detail: A fallback file that reads but lacks every missing codepoint (raylib compacts to ng==0) returns success with the requested glyphs absent — inconsistent with the fail-loud path directly above; only the font_warning_glyph_in_merged_atlas pin on committed assets would catch a future fallback swap.
recommended_fix: In font_merge_fallback, treat fg==nil || ng==0 with missing_n>0 as failure: return nil, 0 (the atlas would lack requested codepoints; the load should refuse).

title: New font tests leak the raylib-owned glyph blocks, recs arrays, and one atlas image
evidence: font_guard_reports_missing_asset: `_, _, ok := font_atlas_build_from_file(FONT_ASSET)` (line 72) discards font and atlas with no free. font_mono_tabular_digits: `mono, am, okm := font_atlas_build_from_file(FONT_MONO_ASSET)` / `defer rl.UnloadImage(am)` (106,111) and `body, ab, okb := font_atlas_build_from_file(FONT_ASSET)` / `defer rl.UnloadImage(ab)` (112,117) free only the images — mono/body .glyphs and .recs (MemAlloc'd by LoadFontData/GenImageFontAtlas) are never freed, unlike the probe's own `defer rl.MemFree(glyphs) // test-side: the merged glyph block is raylib-owned (r3 note)` (line 28).
detail: Inconsistent with the ownership discipline the same file pins at line 28; raylib allocations bypass the Odin tracking allocator, so CI cannot flag them. Small, test-only, but contradicts the diff's own lifecycle comments.
recommended_fix: Free the full lifecycle in the tests: defer rl.MemFree(mono.glyphs)/rl.MemFree(mono.recs) (same for body), and UnloadImage the guard test's happy-path atlas instead of discarding it.
